title: Next Chapter — a trilogy about its own making

books.description: The player: a walkthrough of the vanilla-JS audiobook player you are using right now — transcripts, the Full/Summary toggle, offline — each feature traced to the prompt that shaped it.
The generator: the skill and build scripts that turned each of these repositories into its audiobook, feature by feature, with the prompts that steered them.
The assembly: the public site, the verbatim prompt trail, and the config mirror — the features of building in public, and the prompts behind them.
